name: life-tracker
description: Phone-first PWA for logging games, sleep, anime and photos into your own Supabase and Google Cloud Storage.

paragraphs: You keep small records on your phone: the games you play, how you slept, the anime you watched, the photos worth keeping. Tap a tile on your home screen, fill in a short form or pick photos, and the entry lands in your own Supabase database with images in your own Google Cloud Storage buckets.
Only Game Record ships its database schema. The other pages read tables you create yourself, so a fresh copy shows Game Record alone.
features: Game log: each game gets dated entries with what you did, a one-line note, an optional counter, and screenshots stored as the original plus 1920 px and 640 px WebP copies with the photo's capture time read from EXIF.
Phone first: the app installs to the home screen as a PWA, and cover and gallery photos are resized in the browser before they upload.
Deduplicated images: every file is named by its SHA-256 hash, so the same photo uploaded twice is stored once.

Forum digest: a scheduled GitHub Actions job reads the Gamer.com.tw headlines and a list of Bahamut forum boards twice a day, drops posts matching a keyword blocklist, and commits the result as public/daily-news.json…

requirements.text: You need a Supabase project, a Google Cloud project with billing enabled, a Vercel account (or any Node.js host), and Node.js 22 with pnpm for one local step.
